title: Sootglass Diviner
text: Sootglass Diviner reads cooling ash in a hand mirror and attacks the future in which the operative escapes. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: Its predictions are simply threats spoken early.

defeatReward.text: Sootglass Diviner is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
